comparison.objective: Open a spot-welder battery lid and tip its cell into a collection box.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture holding, small-latch pressing, pouring, and replacing the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Latch actuated, lid open over 60°, cell contained, welder replaced upright, arms released and parked; no dropped cell or welder.
comparison.reason: This is latch release and gravity-assisted removal of an intact cell. It does not require aligned impact tooling, controlled fracture, coil retention, or millimetre-scale fragment recovery.
